ask: muse mkae a splitter for the subs plz
sentence: Splits the cost of shared subscriptions evenly among the people who use each one, shows what each person owes the payer, and lets people mark themselves (or the payer mark them) as paid back.
use_when: A group shares several subscriptions like streaming or wifi and one person pays each bill
People want to see who still owes whom for recurring shared bills
Members need to join or leave a subscription and have the share recalculated
The payer wants to track and confirm who has paid them back
dont_use_when: Splitting a one-off bill or a restaurant check with uneven items
Tracking many mixed expenses with custom unequal shares
Settling up total balances across the whole group with fewest transfers
